answer_2.quote: we report the token precision, recall and F1-score to evaluate the quality of selected rationales. ... we also employ accuracy (Acc), macro-precision (MP), macro-recall (MR), and macro-F1 (F1) to evaluate the performance of yielding judgment results.

answer_4.quote: we sample 100 examples and ask three annotators ... evaluate rationales ... we employ three metrics with an interval from 1 (lowest) to 5 ... including usefulness (U), completeness (C), and fluency (F).
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to rate each rationale on usefulness, completeness, and fluency using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
